newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt selling one mln tonnes cement to Malaysia.
newsitem.headline: Egypt selling one mln tonnes cement to Malaysia.

text.p: Egypt has contracted to sell Malaysia a million tonnes of cement to compensate for slow sales on the domestic market, Public Enterprise Minister Atef Obeid said in an interview published on Wednesday.
"This summer demand (for cement) has fallen because building activity has decreased in the shanty towns," he told the weekly magazine al-Mussawar.
"So two weeks ago we made a deal to export a million tonnes to Malaysia at an attractive price. Since we have opened the door to imports we must open it for exports," he added.
The minister gave no details of the fall in demand but he noted that domestic cement production this year would be 750,000 tonnes higher than in 1996.
Egypt produced 17.8 million tonnes of cement in 1996, about 1.5 million tonnes short of demand. It imported the balance from cheap producers such as Turkey and Romania.
The minister said he had set up a council of cement companies to monitor and stabilise the market.

Cement production in Egypt is dominated by five big listed companies -- Alexandria Portland Cement, Egyptian Tora Portland Cement, Helwan Portland Cement, National Cement (Kawmia) and Suez Cement. They are among the dominant shares on the exchange.
Other private companies are investing in the sector in the expectation that demand will grow.
